overview: RAS is a framework that dynamically constructs question-specific knowledge graphs through iterative retrieval planning and structured knowledge building, enabling LLMs to reason over progressively organized knowledge tailored to each query, evaluated across seven knowledge-intensive benchmarks.

modules.name: HotpotQA-SUBQ Dataset Construction Pipeline
modules.description: Constructs the training dataset from HotpotQA by filtering irrelevant supporting documents via LLM-based assessment, generating document-specific subqueries iteratively, and labeling samples with [NO_RETRIEVAL], [SUBQ], or [SUFFICIENT] tags to produce planning and answering training instances.

modules.name: Text-to-Triples Extraction Model
modules.description: Implements and trains a sequence-to-sequence model on the WikiOFGraph corpus to convert raw text passages into structured subject-predicate-object triples in the standardized format, supporting both training from scratch and inference with optimization frameworks for throughput.

modules.name: Graph Construction and Encoding Module
modules.description: Converts extracted triples into graph structures with node and edge sets, enriches them with semantic embeddings via Sentence-BERT, and implements incremental merging of new subgraph knowledge into the evolving question-specific knowledge graph across iterations.

modules.name: Graph Transformer Encoder with Projection
modules.description: Implements the Graph Transformer architecture for encoding potentially disconnected subgraphs corresponding to different subqueries, followed by mean pooling across subgraph embeddings and a projection layer to produce representations compatible with the LLM input space.

modules.name: Knowledge-Aware Planning Module
modules.description: Implements the iterative planning logic where the model assesses the current knowledge state (encoded KG and subquery-triples history) and outputs one of three plans: [NO_RETRIEVAL] to answer directly, [SUBQ] with a focused subquery targeting knowledge gaps, or [SUFFICIENT] to terminate retrieval.

modules.name: Iterative Retrieval Engine
modules.description: Implements dense and sparse retrieval over partitioned corpus indices, supporting both Contriever-MS MARCO and BM25 retrievers with configurable top-k selection, and integrates with the planning module to execute subquery-driven iterative retrieval across multiple iterations.

modules.name: Knowledge-Augmented Answering Module
modules.description: Generates final answers conditioned on the accumulated question-specific knowledge graph encoding and the complete subquery-chain history, supporting both retrieval-free direct answering and graph-grounded structured reasoning with task-specific instruction templates.

modules.name: Structure-Aware Multitask Training Pipeline
modules.description: Implements joint training of planning and answering capabilities under a unified next-token prediction objective using a Graph LLM backbone, applying LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning on graph components and sharing parameters across both tasks with random task sampling per instance.

modules.name: RAS Inference Orchestrator
modules.description: Coordinates the full iterative inference loop: initial planning decision, followed by repeated cycles of subquery generation, text retrieval, triple extraction, graph enrichment, and re-planning, terminating when [SUFFICIENT] or maximum iteration is reached, then triggering answer generation.

modules.name: Closed-Source Model Adaptation Layer
modules.description: Implements the few-shot prompting interface for proprietary LLMs, including specialized prompt templates for text-to-triples conversion, planning decisions, and answer generation, handling the interaction protocol without graph encoding components.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Implements all paper evaluation metrics: golden match accuracy for short-form QA with normalized string containment, token-level F1 for multi-hop QA, accuracy for closed-set tasks, and ROUGE-LSum plus MAUVE score for long-form generation quality assessment.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluation Runner
modules.description: Manages end-to-end evaluation across all seven benchmarks (TriviaQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, PopQA, PubHealth, ARC-Challenge, ASQA, ELI5) with dataset-specific inference configurations including static vs. dynamic retrieval, web search integration, and predetermined context settings.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis Framework
modules.description: Implements controlled ablation experiments covering training-phase removals (graph encoding, LoRA, text-to-triple conversion, multi-task learning) and inference-phase removals (retrieval, graph encoding, planning), as well as graph information abundance studies and training data volume scaling analysis.

modules.name: Configuration and Experiment Management
modules.description: Provides YAML-based experiment configuration with inheritance, distributed index partitioning for retrieval, vLLM-accelerated triple extraction inference, training checkpoint persistence, FAISS-based dense indexing, and automated result aggregation for comparison tables.
